name: Fabricated Metals
old_description: Fabricated Metals is a U.S. based manufacturer who provides custom design and fabrication of metal products.
about:
Fabricated Metals operates from Louisville, Kentucky, where it was founded in 1955. The company remains a privately held, family-owned business, having grown from its origins as a metal fabrication shop into a preferred partner for original equipment manufacturers in the rail, transit, communication, and energy storage sectors.

The company provides full-service engineering, design, fabrication, and integration of custom metal products. Its core offerings include instrument houses, enclosures, junction boxes, battery cabinets, steel foundations, and submersible enclosures tested to withstand full immersion. Fabricated Metals runs high-production fabrication lines capable of working with steel up to 12 gauge, supporting both small and large-scale manufacturing runs.

Primary customers are OEMs in the railroad, communication, transit, power generation, and energy storage industries. The firm has developed specialized solutions for major railroad and transit agencies, as well as for communication infrastructure and power distribution equipment.

Fabricated Metals emphasizes a family-oriented culture and a tenured workforce with decades of experience. A dedicated research and development team continuously prototypes new products to meet evolving industry regulations, while a quality management system guides process improvements across all operations.
